newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Revenues are Russia's most pressing problem-Chubais.
newsitem.headline: Revenues are Russia's most pressing problem-Chubais.

text.p: First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais told a news conference on Wednesday that budget revenue was Russia's "hottest and most acute problem at the moment" and changes were urgently needed there.
Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin said that tax collection remained an extremely difficult problem for Russia in March, although revenues from the customs service had risen slightly.
He said Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Kulikov would retain day-to-day charge of Russia's tax and customs services.

But foreign trade activities and policy-making in the tax and customs services would be the responsibity of Alfred Kokh, another deputy prime minister who deals with privatisation and who is close to Chubais.
Chubais is in overall charge of all these services.
